requirement: Reasonix model-verification reason, explicit model scope and restart recovery using normal desktop Settings UI
scope: current Mac and current Reasonix 2.31.0 account
proof absent/legacy-source-change explanation; independent wallet presentation
normal explicit selection of deepseek/deepseek-flash and one small verification request; no other model
fresh evidence timestamps, model selection scope, normal Quit/restart retaining native proof
natural 24-hour expiry remains a separate elapsed-time condition
nonGoals: changing system time or manually editing evidence/app database
runtime injection or setting store values
modelRequestPolicy: one explicit UI verification only, stop on first failed or unexpected request; no automatic retries or renewals
environment: normal existing HOME/network/proxy and CLI sandbox; independent native app data and standard incognito WebView; no credentials copied

build.cache: APFS copy-on-write clone of previous external tokage-desktop-test-7bc4dhz3 release target if present; do not reuse bundle as new candidate
build.signing: ordinary local ad-hoc signing only after normal release build; strict verify required

acceptance: Demo and Debug disabled; online usage defaults off
initial Reasonix state never inferred as logged out solely from missing/old proof
model select and token notice visible; exact chosen model passed by normal UI
successful real verification records native schema2 model/path and original timestamps; no credentials in evidence
unverified second model not selectable for tasks
normal Quit and restart preserve proof times and selected model scope
ordinary scanning never issues automatic model verification
natural >=24h expiry changes proof state, retains time/wallet and blocks model selection without paid renewal
limits: ephemeral WebView cannot certify all frontend setting persistence
CLI-owned HOME/cache/history may be written by its normal verification; no full HOME isolation claim
native proof file may use its existing protected Tokage location; inspect location read-only and do not copy or alter it
24h criterion cannot be represented by shortened TTL or fixture time
stopping: stop on unanticipated trust/auth prompt, credential change, wrong model, extra paid request or app/build failure; preserve failed attempts
